description: i’m celebrating national chocolate chip cookie day the only way one should be celebrating, with the the best browned butter chocolate chip cookies of all time. don’t believe me? these bb’s have over 5 million pageviews on my site and counting ;) recipe in my profile! #chocolatechipcookies #easybaking #cookierecipe
transcript: It's national chocolate chip cookie day and while I usually think of national food holidays as kind of weird I will take any excuse to honor the humble chocolate chip cookie I will also go to bat stating that these particular cookies are the best chocolate chip cookies of all time And here's why first the all-important sugar ratio the ratio of brown to white sugars in these cookies make them have both Perfectly crispy edges and that gooey chewy middle that melts in your mouth They also use one egg and one egg yolk This gives these cookies a perfect amount of structure to be chewy but not cakey and as you saw earlier The base of this cookie is brown butter, which is basically toasted butter meaning your cookies have this wonderful depth and complexity And to make these cookies look as good as they taste I always reserve a few chocolate chips to place on top of my cookies before they go into the fridge to chill and the whole Chilling thing I get it. It's annoying But think of it this way the time in the fridge allows the flavors to deepen the gluons to soften and the sugars to break down Trust me, it is worth it And I feel like the results speak for themselves as always you can find the full recipe in my profile and happy celebrating
